327352.overview: Citadel is an adventure game in text mode developed by the late Loriciels company on the Oric 1 / Atmos and Philips VG5000 computers. It was ported to EXL100 and improved by Tom and Jerry, of the GPA group.

327393.overview: CB5 is a reflex game, in five paintings, for one or two players. Using your rackets, you must return a ball to the bricks of an array. When all the bricks are destroyed, you access the following table, the level of difficulty of which increases.

330213.overview: Lost in the huge Inca pyramid, will you find the hieroglyphic room? Will you perceive the secret by finding the translation of these hieroglyphs, which will allow you to prolong your survival? Will you avoid pitfalls, by fighting against the flight of time? when the last hieroglyph has been engraved and when you have gathered all the objects necessary to open the doors of the Golden City, you will be freed from the spell it exercised over you.
